game.title: Pundo
game.description: A traditional game similar to bowling, played with flat stones. Players slide stones along the ground toward a target stone, competing for accuracy.
howToPlay: Step 1: A target stone is placed at one end of a smooth playing area.
Step 2: Players stand at a marked throwing line.
Step 3: Each player slides their flat stone along the ground toward the target.
Step 4: Points are awarded based on how close the stone lands to the target.
Step 5: Players can knock opponents' stones away from the target.
Step 6: The player whose stone is closest after all throws scores.
Step 7: Multiple rounds are played with cumulative scoring.
Step 8: Players develop touch and control for precise sliding.
Step 9: The game requires minimal equipment and space.
Step 10: Friendly competition and socializing accompany the game.
